scalars.scalar_value: Minimum of 1 to 2 years of experience as a pharmacy technician, with prior hospital, home infusion, or oncology/sterile compounding experience strongly preferred

items.item_text: Minimum of 1 to 2 years of experience as a pharmacy technician, with prior hospital, home infusion, or oncology/sterile compounding experience strongly preferred

Sterile Compounding: Prepare complex intravenous admixtures, chemotherapy, monoclonal antibodies, and other parenteral medications using strict aseptic techniques in ISO-classified cleanrooms and biological safety cabinets.
Order Processing & Labeling: Review physician medication orders (under pharmacist supervision), perform pharmaceutical calculations, and accurately label finished products with patient and drug data.

Cleanroom Safety & Maintenance: Follow proper personal protective equipment (PPE) donning and doffing procedures; complete routine cleaning and environmental monitoring of the cleanroom and hazardous drug (HD) rooms.
Inventory Management: Monitor stock levels, track expiration dates, rotate pharmaceuticals, and stock automated dispensing cabinets or cold-storage units.

Compliance & Documentation: Maintain accurate manufacturing records, batch logs, waste disposal logs, and quality assurance logs in accordance with state and federal laws (HIPAA, FDA, state board regulations).
Collaboration: Communicate professionally with clinical pharmacists, infusion nurses, and healthcare providers regarding drug availability, dosages, or delivery timelines.
Able to follow both oral and written directions.
Ability to read and communicate accurately and legibly.
Ability to be precise in filling medication orders and maintaining records.
Ability to work tactfully and effectively with team members, the patient, family, and the public.
